title: Aussie Slow Cooked Swede Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting casserole made with tender swede, slow-cooked to perfection. This Australian-inspired dish is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: In a large casserole dish, combine sliced swede, chopped onion, and minced garlic.
Add sliced mushrooms, canned diced tomatoes, and Australian bush tomato sauce to the casserole dish.
Pour in vegetable stock and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the casserole dish to the preheated oven and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and top with grated cheddar cheese.
Return the casserole to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Sprinkle breadcrumbs on top of the casserole and bake for a further 2-3 minutes, or until golden brown.
